DML.SELECT: SELECT element_type_id as "elementTypeId", element_id as "elementId", module_type_id as "moduleTypeId", module_id as "moduleId", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible", created_at as "createdAt", updated_at as "updatedAt" FROM conf.element_io_controller_modules WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.element_io_controller_modules (element_type_id, element_id, module_type_id, module_id, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:elementTypeId, :elementId, :moduleTypeId, :moduleId, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
